title: Templars persecuted by Philip the Fair and burned in 1307

tellings.quote: spitting on the cross. And they all ended up getting burnt at the stake in 1307.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of the Knights Templar, a medieval order of Christian knights, who were accused of rituals such as spitting on the cross. He says that under the French king Philip the Fair they were persecuted and all ended up burned at the stake in 1307. He raises it while discussing secret knowledge and the groups said to have held it.
